items.briefing:
Origin Energy is currently investigating an alleged cyber incident involving data, a reminder that Australian energy providers remain attractive targets. More broadly, IBM's latest research confirms Australian data breaches now cost organisations an average of AUD $4.22 million — reinforcing why security investment matters. Finance teams are also being warned about a rise in behavioural attacks, where scammers manipulate staff psychologically rather than using technical hacks, making awareness training especially important.

AI-generated bot traffic now reportedly exceeds human web traffic, increasing the risk of automated scams and fraud targeting Australian businesses and individuals. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected request to transfer funds or share data — even from a known contact — verify it by phone before acting.

featured.title: Origin Energy probes alleged cyber incident over data
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider's data breach puts millions of customers at direct scam risk.
